meta.name: Ar-Rayaan Master Module Registry
meta.law: Every module the founder ever designed lives here with its true status. This file is the answer to 'what did we miss' - it must never drift from reality, and the W9 test enforces that.

statuses.walled: built but hidden (no entrance or gate)
statuses.gated: built but held by a lawful gate (review/pending key)

modules.title: Sunnah Engine / Lamha
modules.surface: A card on the Home screen (LamhaEngine); it has no screen of its own, so no route.

modules.title: Huda - worship guides
modules.note: 48 guides in 5 categories (Worship, Daily Adab, Sacred Spaces, The Last Day, Hajj & Umrah) as of 2026-10-20; assets/guides/guides.json is the source of truth.

modules.title: Wasia Academy (gate, Wasia AI, curriculum, exams)
Stories library (11 collections)
modules.note: 7 story collections (prophets, women, seerah, companions, ghayb, signs, tales) plus khutbahs, daily duas, hadiths for our times and the New Muslim path, all listed on the one /stories screen.

modules.note: Lives inside the Stories library (collection "khutbahs"); there is no khutbah-only screen.

modules.title: Healing (Sakina)
modules.note: pathways gated on clinician+scholar review - the law

modules.title: Community (Courtyard forum)
modules.note: Routed (/majlis, /majlis/thread/:id, /majlis/new) and linked from Explore, but gated: it needs the founder's Firebase project, and the starter rooms/threads the client tries to seed are rejected by firestore.rules (rooms are write:false, seed threads use uid "seed"). Not live until the backend owner resolves seeding.
